title: Water Conservation
status: draft: written 18 Nov 2026 offline for Grade 5 Agriculture; not yet checked by a CBC Agriculture teacher; not loaded by the live tutor
notes: Run the mulch test in two equal tins or beds for a week; the class records the soil feel each morning.

skills.key_step: The child names ways of conserving water in a household garden (water in the evening or early morning, mulch, drip irrigation, reuse safe household water, harvest rain, sunken beds, weed) and says why each saves water.

floor.question: Where does drip put the water?

steps: Water the roots, not the leaves.
contexts: a kitchen garden in a dry month

board.do: Write "water at noon or in the evening?".
Ask which keeps more water in the soil.
Write "less water dries up when it is cool".

listen_for: At midday when the sun is hottest
misconceptions.ask: When is it best to water a garden to save water?
misconceptions.repair: Pour a cup of water on the ground at noon and one at six in the evening and compare how long each stays damp.

listen_for: It keeps the plants warm at night
misconceptions.ask: What does a layer of dry grass around kale do for the water in the soil?
misconceptions.repair: Uncover a mulched patch and a bare patch at midday and feel both.

listen_for: Pouring much more water on it each day
misconceptions.ask: A garden dries out quickly. Which action saves water?
misconceptions.repair: Ask where the water went. Then show that a cover stops it escaping.

listen_for: None, garden water must be fresh
misconceptions.ask: Which water can be reused on garden plants?
misconceptions.repair: Pour vegetable-washing water on a bed and watch the plants over a week.

checks.question: Give two ways to conserve water in a garden.
checks.answer: any two of mulch, drip, watering when cool, reuse, harvest rain

checks.question: Why water in the evening?
checks.answer: less water is lost to the sun

skills.key_step: The child plans a fair test (two beds the same in soil, crop, water and sun, one mulched) and reads the result (the mulched bed stays damp longer).

floor.question: What is mulch?
floor.answer: a cover of dry plant material on the soil

steps: Feel and record the soil each day; compare.

board.do: Draw two tins, one with grass on top.
Ask which will be drier after three sunny days.
Write the result: bare tin driest.

listen_for: Nothing is wrong, this is fair
misconceptions.ask: To test mulch, Otieno gives the mulched bed less water and plants beans there and kale in the other bed. What is wrong?
misconceptions.repair: Ask what Otieno could blame if the mulched bed did better.

misconceptions.ask: After a week of sun, which bed will stay damp longer, the mulched one or the bare one?
misconceptions.repair: Do the test: dig a finger deep in both beds and feel.

listen_for: Look at the top of the soil
misconceptions.ask: How should you check how damp the soil is in the mulching test?
misconceptions.repair: Dig a finger into both beds two days after watering: the bare one is dry below the crust.

misconceptions.ask: When should the results of a mulching test be read?
misconceptions.repair: Show the record sheet: on day one both beds feel the same, by day five they differ.

checks.question: In a fair test, what is changed?
What result shows mulch conserves water?
checks.answer: the mulched soil stays damp longer
